articles.summary: During the Masco Month of Service in September, over 60 Behr team members joined thousands of volunteers from across the country on the anniversary of 9/11 for a nationwide beautification of military cemeteries led by Behr’s nonprofit partner Carry The Load. Employees from over a dozen states participated, cleaning headstones at 15 locations spanning from Brooklyn’s Cypress Hills National Cemetery (NY) to San Bruno’s Golden Gate National Cemetery (CA). Matt Knight, Vice President of Sales- West Region and the leader of Behr’s Veterans Employee Group, volunteered at Riverside National Cemetery in CA. “This experience is incredibly rewarding in many ways.…
articles.title: Behr Participates in Nationwide Cleanup of Military Cemeteries

articles.summary: When Masco President and CEO, Jon Nudi, declared September 2025 a Month of Service, the small but mighty team at Endless Pools—a division of Watkins Wellness based in Aston, PA—dreamed up the concept of “SWIMTember,” a month dedicated to leveraging their passion around water safety to make a positive impact in the community. SWIMTember challenged employees to swim in an Endless Pool in order to earn donations for the local YMCA. With teams competing under the leadership of six captains, the grand total came to 235 swims, which raised enough funds to provide free swim lessons for more than 150…
articles.title: Endless Pools Makes a Difference during “SWIMTember”
